intro_en: In this lesson you will tell the story of a herder's son who rose from the countryside to the top, and discuss opportunity, privilege, and connections. You will also learn the Mongolian -тлаа ... болох pattern for a change that reaches a point, and the English contrast between "so ... that" and "so much so that."
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр та хөдөөний малчны хүү оргилд хүртэл дэвшсэн түүхийг ярьж, боломж, давуу эрх, танил талын тухай ярилцаж сурна. Мөн монгол хэлний -тлаа ... болох хэлбэр, англи хэлний "so ... that" ба "so much so that" хоёрын ялгааг үзнэ.

vocab.example_mn: Түүний аав насаараа малчин хүн байсан.
vocab.example_en: His father was a herder all his life.
Opportunities are scarce for children in the countryside.

vocab.example_mn: Баян айлын хүүхдүүд давуу эрхээ анзаардаггүй.
vocab.example_en: Kids from wealthy families don't notice their privilege.
Connections matter a lot in Mongolia.
She received a scholarship to study abroad.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр гурван жилийн дотор менежер болж дэвшсэн.
vocab.example_en: He rose to manager within three years.
Many people got rich through mining.

vocab.example_mn: Хот, хөдөөгийн тэгш бус байдал улам нэмэгдэж байна.
vocab.example_en: Inequality between the city and the countryside keeps growing.

vocab.example_mn: Түүний амжилт олон залууд урам өгсөн.
vocab.example_en: His success inspired many young people.

sentences.en: He got so rich that he became a different person.
alt_en: He became so wealthy that he turned into a different person.

sentences.mn: Бат тэтгэлэг авч их сургуульд ортлоо малаа хариулж байсан.
sentences.en: Bat herded livestock until he got a scholarship and entered university.
alt_en: Bat tended the herd until he won a scholarship and started university.
sentences.mn_latin: Bat tetgeleg avch ikh surguulid ortloo malaa khariulj baisan.

sentences.en: His company grew so much that it became famous.
alt_en: His company grew to the point of becoming famous.

sentences.mn: Хөдөөний хүүхдүүдэд хотын хүүхдүүдтэй адил боломж байдаггүй.
sentences.en: Children in the countryside don't have the same opportunities as city kids.
alt_en: Rural children don't have the same opportunities as children in the city.
sentences.mn_latin: Khödöönii khüükhdüüded khotyn khüükhdüüdtei adil bolomj baidaggüi.

sentences.mn: Танил талгүй бол сайн ажилд ороход хэцүү.
sentences.en: Without connections, it's hard to get a good job.
alt_mn: Танил тал байхгүй бол сайн ажилд ороход хэцүү.
alt_en: It's hard to land a good job without connections.
sentences.mn_latin: Tanil talgüi bol sain ajild orokhod khetsüü.

sentences.mn: Тэр өөрийн давуу эрхийг огт анзаардаггүй.
sentences.en: He never notices his own privilege.
alt_en: He's completely unaware of his own privilege.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter ööriin davuu erkhiig ogt anzaardaggüi.

sentences.mn: Тэр энгийн ажилчнаас захирал болтлоо дэвшсэн.
sentences.en: He rose from an ordinary worker all the way to director.
alt_en: He worked his way up from an ordinary worker to director.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter engiin ajilchnaas zakhiral boltloo devshsen.

sentences.mn: Тэр гэр бүлээ мартах шахтлаа ажилласан.
sentences.en: He worked hard, so much so that he nearly forgot his family.
alt_en: He worked so hard that he almost forgot his family.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter ger bülee martakh shakhtlaa ajillasan.

sentences.mn: Хотод хэдэн жил амьдраад тэр нутгийн аялгаа мартчихтлаа болсон.
sentences.en: After a few years in the city, he had reached the point of forgetting his local accent.
alt_en: After living in the city for a few years, he had gotten to where he'd forgotten his home accent.
sentences.mn_latin: Khotod kheden jil amidraad ter nutgiin ayalgaa martchikhtlaa bolson.

sentences.mn: Нийгмийн шилжилт хөдөлгөөн бага улсад ядуу хүн ядуугаараа үлддэг.
sentences.en: In a country with low social mobility, poor people stay poor.
alt_en: Where social mobility is low, the poor remain poor.
sentences.mn_latin: Niigmiin shiljilt khödölgöön baga ulsad yaduu khün yaduugaaraa ülddeg.

sentences.mn: Түүний амжилт азаас биш, хөдөлмөрөөс шалтгаалсан.
sentences.en: His success came not from luck but from hard work.
alt_mn: Түүний амжилт аз биш, хөдөлмөрийн үр дүн.
alt_en: His success was the result of hard work, not luck.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüünii amjilt azaas bish, khödölmöröös shaltgaalsan.

sentences.mn: Тэтгэлэг бол хөдөөний залуучуудад нээгдэх хамгийн том боломж.
sentences.en: A scholarship is the biggest opportunity open to young people from the countryside.
alt_en: For rural youth, a scholarship is the greatest opportunity there is.
sentences.mn_latin: Tetgeleg bol khödöönii zaluuchuudad neegdekh khamgiin tom bolomj.

grammar.title_en: -тлаа ... болох (to the point that) and so ... that vs. so much so that
grammar.title_mn: -тлаа ... болох ба "so ... that" / "so much so that"
grammar.explain_en: The Mongolian suffix -тлаа/-тлээ/-тлоо/-тлөө (vowel harmony) means "until" or "to the point that." It shows that an action or change went so far that it reached a new state: баяжтлаа өөр хүн болсон means "he got rich to the point of becoming a different person." With болох it means "has reached the point where": сургуульд ортлоо болсон means "has grown old enough to start school." Choose the ending by the stem's vowels: баяж → баяжтлаа, ор → ортлоо, хүр → хүртлээ, өс → өстлөө.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд "so + тэмдэг нэр/дайвар + that" нь нэг өгүүлбэр дотор хэр зэрэг, үр дүнг хамт илэрхийлнэ: He was so rich that he bought a plane. Харин ", so much so that" нь бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн дараа таслалтай ирж, "тэр хэмжээнд хүртэл" гэсэн утгаар өмнөх санааг онцолно: He worked hard, so much so that he got sick. Нэр үгтэй бол "such (a) ... that" хэрэглэнэ: It was such a good chance that he couldn't refuse. Монгол хэлний -тлаа хэлбэр ихэвчлэн эдгээрээр орчуулагддаг.

examples.en: He got so rich that he became a different person.
Their son has grown old enough to start school.
He worked hard, so much so that he was exhausted.
The village had changed so much that it was unrecognizable.

fill_blank.translation: He got so rich that he became a different person.
fill_blank.explain_en: The stem баяж- has the back vowel а, so vowel harmony requires -тлаа.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Үгийн язгуур "баяж" нь а эгшигтэй тул эгшиг зохицох ёсоор -тлаа залгана.

fill_blank.translation: Their son has grown old enough to start school.
fill_blank.explain_en: The stem ор- has the vowel о, so the ending is -тлоо. With болох it means the child has reached that point.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Ор" язгуур о эгшигтэй тул -тлоо болно. Болох үйл үгтэй хамт тухайн хэмжээнд хүрснийг илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.text: Танил ___ бол сайн ажилд ороход хэцүү.
fill_blank.translation: Without connections, it's hard to get a good job.
fill_blank.explain_en: -гүй means "without," and the meaning "it's hard" requires lacking connections.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Хэцүү" гэсэн утгатай нийцэхийн тулд "байхгүй" гэсэн утгатай -гүй дагавар хэрэгтэй.

fill_blank.text: He was ___ poor that he couldn't afford shoes.
fill_blank.translation: Тэр гутал авч чадахгүй тийм ядуу байсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: Before an adjective with no noun (poor), use "so ... that." "Such" needs a noun, and "too" takes "to," not "that."
fill_blank.explain_mn: Нэр үггүй тэмдэг нэрийн өмнө "so ... that" хэрэглэнэ. "Such" нь нэр үг шаарддаг, "too" нь "that"-тай хэрэглэгддэггүй.

fill_blank.text: She worked hard, so ___ so that she fell ill.
fill_blank.explain_en: The fixed phrase is "so much so that." It comes after a full clause and a comma.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "So much so that" нь тогтмол хэллэг. Бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн дараа таслалтай ирнэ.

fill_blank.text: It was ___ a great opportunity that he couldn't refuse.
fill_blank.translation: Энэ бол түүний татгалзаж чадахгүй тийм том боломж байсан.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "a + тэмдэг нэр + нэр үг"-ийн өмнө "so" биш "such" хэрэглэнэ.

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Чи Батын түүхийг сонссон уу? Говийн малчны хүү байсан шүү дээ.
dialogue.en: Have you heard Bat's story? He was a herder's son from the Gobi.
dialogue.mn_latin: Chi Batyn tüükhiig sonsson uu? Goviin malchny khüü baisan shüü dee.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.mn: Сонссон. Одоо том компанийн захирал болтлоо дэвшсэн гэсэн.
dialogue.en: I have. I heard he's risen all the way to director of a big company.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sonsson. Odoo tom kompaniin zakhiral boltloo devshsen gesen.

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ. Арван найман нас хүртлээ мал хариулж, дараа нь тэтгэлгээр их сургуульд орсон.
dialogue.en: Yes. He herded livestock until he was eighteen, then got into university on a scholarship.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee. Arvan naiman nas khürtlee mal khariulj, daraa ni tetgelgeer ikh surguulid orson.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.mn: Танил талгүй байж ийм амжилт гаргана гэдэг ховор шүү.
dialogue.en: Achieving that kind of success without connections is rare.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tanil talgüi baij iim amjilt gargana gedeg khovor shüü.

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Үнэн. Тэр шөнө ч унтах завгүй болтлоо ажилладаг байсан гэсэн.
dialogue.en: True. Apparently he worked so hard that he had no time even to sleep.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ünen. Ter shönö ch untakh zavgüi boltloo ajilladag baisan gesen.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.en: Getting rich hasn't changed him, has it?

dialogue.speaker: Saraa
dialogue.mn: Үгүй ээ, тэр одоо ч жил бүр нутагтаа очиж, хөдөөний хүүхдүүдэд тэтгэлэг өгдөг.
dialogue.en: No, he still goes back to his home region every year and gives scholarships to rural kids.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ügüi ee, ter odoo ch jil bür nutagtaa ochij, khödöönii khüükhdüüded tetgeleg ögdög.

culture_note.en: Since the 1990s, many herders' children have moved to Ulaanbaatar for education, and some have risen to the top of business and politics. Mongolians openly debate how much "танил тал" (connections) matters compared with hard work. Successful people are often expected to give back to their home soum, for example by funding schools, scholarships, or Naadam celebrations.
culture_note.mn: 1990-ээд оноос хойш олон малчны хүүхэд боловсрол эзэмшихээр Улаанбаатарт шилжин ирсэн бөгөөд зарим нь бизнес, улс төрийн оргилд хүрсэн. Хөдөлмөрөөс илүү танил тал чухал уу гэдгийг монголчууд нээлттэй ярилцдаг. Амжилтад хүрсэн хүмүүс нутаг сумынхаа сургууль, тэтгэлэг, наадамд дэмжлэг үзүүлж, нутагтаа хувь нэмрээ оруулах ёстой гэж олон хүн үздэг.

review.notes: Solid lesson with accurate vowel-harmony explanations and a sound fill-in section. The fixes cover one unidiomatic English intro line, one misused -тлаа in the dialogue, an age expression, and a calque in the culture note.

opus_fix.notes: A solid lesson. One Mongolian line was ambiguous and one English word choice for нутаг was off; I fixed both.

changes.why: "Тэр шөнө" reads as "that night," which clashes with the habitual -даг. Reworded to say "even at night."
нутаг here means his home area. "Homeland" sounds like his country.
